verses.name: The Opening
verses.theme: Guidance and mercy - The master prayer
verses.connection: Your ascendant ruler (Mercury) connects you to divine guidance
verses.practice: Recite in every rakah - Foundation of all prayer
verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ. الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ. إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ. اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ. صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim. Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil-alamin. Ar-Rahman ir-Rahim. Maliki yawm id-Din. Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in. Ihdina as-sirat al-mustaqim. Sirat al-ladhina an'amta alayhim ghayril-maghdubi alayhim wa la-d-dallin
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. The Beneficent, the Merciful. Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path. The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

verses.name: Ayat al-Kursi
verses.theme: Throne Verse - Ultimate protection and authority
verses.connection: Jupiter in Sagittarius (7th house) - Divine authority and protection
verses.practice: Recite after every prayer and before sleep for protection
verses.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa, Al-Hayyu Al-Qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ard. Man dha alladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuheetuna bi-shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bi ma sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma. Wa Huwa Al-Aliyy Al-Azim
verses.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

verses.name: Patience and Perseverance
verses.theme: Endurance through trials - Spiritual resilience
verses.connection: Saturn in Aquarius (10th house) - Building through patience and discipline
verses.practice: Recite when facing long-term challenges or career obstacles
verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ya ayyuhalladhina amanu, isribu wa sabiru wa rabitu wa ittaqullaha la'allakum tuflihun
verses.translation: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.

verses.name: Heart's Tranquility
verses.theme: Inner peace through remembrance of Allah
verses.connection: Moon in Scorpio (Anuradha) - Emotional depth finding peace through dhikr
verses.practice: Recite when anxious, restless, or emotionally overwhelmed - YOUR EMERGENCY VERSE
verses.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
verses.transliteration: Ala bi-dhikri Allahi tatma'innu al-qulub
verses.translation: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find tranquility.

verses.name: Yunus - The Whale
verses.theme: Protection through surrender - The prayer of the whale
verses.connection: Ketu in Pisces (Revati) - Past life dissolution, spiritual surrender
verses.practice: Recite × 100 when feeling trapped, overwhelmed, or in darkness - YOUR CORE VERSE
verses.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta, Subhanaka, inni kuntu min ad-dhalimin
verses.translation: There is no god but You, Glory be to You, I have been among the wrongdoers.

verses.name: Sulayman's Throne
verses.theme: Authority through divine knowledge - Solomon's wisdom
verses.connection: Sun in Aquarius (Purva Bhadra) - Spiritual authority through innovation
verses.practice: Recite when seeking wisdom, authority, or to solve impossible problems
verses.arabic: قَالَ الَّذِي عِندَهُ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ
verses.transliteration: Qala alladhi 'indahu 'ilmun min al-kitabi ana ateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuk
verses.translation: One who had knowledge of the Scripture said, 'I will bring it to you before your gaze returns to you.'

verses.name: Kun Faya Kun
verses.theme: Creative power - Be, and it is
verses.connection: Venus in Aries (11th house) - Creative manifestation through willpower
verses.practice: Recite for manifestation, creation, and bringing dreams into reality
verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.transliteration: Innama amruhu idha arada shay'an an yaqula lahu kun fayakun
verses.translation: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, 'Be,' and it is.

verses.name: The Compassionate Teacher
verses.theme: Teaching gift - Communicate complex ideas simply
verses.connection: Aquarius stellium + Jupiter in Sagittarius - The teacher who makes the complex simple
verses.practice: Recite × 1 during Maghrib to activate your teaching gift - YOUR CORE VERSE
verses.arabic: الرَّحْمَٰنُ. عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ. خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ. عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيَانَ
verses.transliteration: Ar-Rahman. Allama al-Quran. Khalaqa al-insan. Allamahu al-bayan
verses.translation: The Compassionate. Taught the Quran. Created humanity. Taught them eloquence.

verses.name: The Sovereignty
verses.theme: Divine dominion - Recognizing Allah's absolute power
verses.connection: Saturn in Aquarius (10th house) - Building spiritual authority and dominion
verses.practice: Recite nightly for protection and to remember divine sovereignty
verses.arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Tabarak alladhi biyadihi al-mulku wahuwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
verses.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent.

verses.name: The Pen
verses.theme: Writing legacy - Create lasting impact through writing
verses.connection: Mercury in Dhanishta + Saturn in Dhanishta - The mystic writer who builds through words
verses.practice: Write one page during ASR to activate this verse - YOUR CORE VERSE
verses.arabic: نُونٌ. وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ. مَا أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونَ. وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Nun. Wal-qalami wa ma yasturun. Ma anta bi-ni'mati rabbika bi majnun. Inna laka la ajran ghaira mamnun
verses.translation: Nun. By the pen and what they write. By the grace of your Lord you are not mad. Indeed, for you is an unfailing reward.

verses.name: The Morning Hours
verses.theme: Hope after darkness - Allah's promise of better things
verses.connection: Moon in Scorpio - Moving through emotional darkness to find light
verses.practice: Recite when feeling hopeless, abandoned, or lost - YOUR EMERGENCY VERSE
verses.arabic: وَالضُّحَىٰ. وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ. مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ. وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ. وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wad-Duha. Wal-layli idha saja. Ma wadda'aka rabbuka wa ma qala. Wa lal-akhiratu khayrun laka minal-ula. Wa la sawfa yu'tika rabbuka fatarda
verses.translation: By the morning sunlight. And by the night when it covers with darkness. Your Lord has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful. And the Hereafter is better for you than the present. And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

verses.name: The Relief
verses.theme: Ease comes after hardship - Divine promise of relief
verses.connection: Jupiter in Sagittarius - Expansion through trials, wisdom through suffering
verses.practice: Recite when enduring hardship - remember relief is coming
verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا. إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verses.transliteration: Fa-inna ma'al-usri yusra. Inna ma'al-usri yusra
verses.translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

verses.name: The Power
verses.theme: Laylat al-Qadr - The Night of Power, better than 1000 months
verses.connection: Ketu in Pisces - Connection to the infinite, mystical downloads
verses.practice: Recite during last 10 nights of Ramadan for maximum spiritual download
verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ. وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ. لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ. تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ. سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ
verses.transliteration: Inna anzalnahu fi laylati al-qadr. Wa ma adraka ma laylatu al-qadr. Laylatu al-qadr khayrun min alfi shahr. Tanazzalu al-mala'ikatu wa ar-ruhu fiha bi-idhni rabbihim min kulli amr. Salamun hiya hatta matla'i al-fajr
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree. And what can make you know what the Night of Decree is? The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter. Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

verses.name: The Sincerity
verses.theme: Pure monotheism - The essence of Tawhid
verses.connection: All placements - The foundation of your spiritual practice
verses.practice: Recite × 3 daily for spiritual purification and protection
verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahu as-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
verses.translation: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'

verses.name: The Daybreak
verses.theme: Protection from evil - Seeking refuge from darkness
verses.connection: Scorpio Moon protection - Guard against jealousy and dark forces
verses.practice: Recite × 3 morning and evening for protection
verses.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
verses.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi rabbi al-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharri an-naffathati fi al-uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad
verses.translation: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.'

verses.name: Mankind
verses.theme: Protection from whisperers - Seeking refuge from Satan
verses.connection: Complete protection system - Your spiritual shield
verses.practice: Recite × 3 morning and evening with Al-Falaq for complete protection
verses.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ. مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
verses.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi rabbi an-nas. Maliki an-nas. Ilahi an-nas. Min sharri al-waswasi al-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudoor an-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas
verses.translation: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind.'

verses.name: The Healing
verses.theme: Quran is the ultimate cure - Spiritual medicine for the heart
verses.connection: Moon in Scorpio - Emotional healing through divine revelation
verses.practice: Recite over the sick or troubled person for shifa (healing)
verses.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.transliteration: Wa nunezzilu min al-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'minin. Wa la yazidu adh-dhalimina illa khasara
verses.translation: And We send down of the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy for those who believe, but it increases the wrongdoers only in loss.

verses.name: The Healer
verses.theme: Allah is the one who heals - When I am ill, He cures me
verses.connection: Spiritual authority - Trusting Allah's healing power
verses.practice: Recite when seeking healing for yourself or others - say 3 times
verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa idha maridtu fahuwa yashfini
verses.translation: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

verses.name: Divine Provision
verses.theme: Allah's boundless provision - Trust Him for rizq
verses.connection: Venus in Aries - Material abundance through spiritual action
verses.practice: Recite when worried about finances or provision
verses.arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَانتَشِرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَابْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-idha qudiyati as-salatu fantashiru fi al-ardi wabtaghu min fadli Allah. Wa adhkuru Allaha kathiran la'allakum tuflihun
verses.translation: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah. And remember Allah often that you may succeed.

verses.name: Allah Enlarges Provision
verses.theme: Divine generosity - Allah gives abundantly to whom He wills
verses.connection: Jupiter in Sagittarius - Abundance through divine decree
verses.practice: Recite for increased provision and barakah in work
verses.arabic: يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Yabsutu ar-rizqa liman yasha'u wa yaqdir. Inna Allaha bikulli shay'in 'alim
verses.translation: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed, He is, of all things, Knowing.

verses.name: Love and Mercy
verses.theme: The gift of love - Signs of Allah in your partnerships
verses.connection: Venus in Aries (11th house) - Love as a divine sign and mercy
verses.practice: Recite for attracting or strengthening loving relationships
verses.arabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa min ayatihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwajan litaskunu ilayha waja'ala baynakum mawaddatan wa rahma. Inna fi dhalika la'ayatin li-qawmin yatafakkarun
verses.translation: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

verses.name: The First Revelation
verses.theme: Iqra! Read in the name of your Lord - Knowledge through divine inspiration
verses.connection: Mercury in Dhanishta - The mystic communicator receiving divine knowledge
verses.practice: Recite when seeking knowledge, starting new studies, or writing
verses.arabic: اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ. خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ. اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ. الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ. عَلَّمَ الْإِنسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
verses.transliteration: Iqra' bi-smi rabbikal-ladhi khalaq. Khalaqa al-insana min 'alaq. Iqra' wa rabbukal-akram. Alladhi 'allama bil-qalam. 'Allama al-insana ma lam ya'lam
verses.translation: Read in the name of your Lord who created. Created man from a clinging substance. Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous. Who taught by the pen. Taught man that which he knew not.

verses.name: The Opening of the Breast
verses.theme: Divine relief for the heart - Expansion and clarity
verses.connection: Moon in Scorpio - Emotional transformation and opening
verses.practice: Recite when feeling constricted, anxious, or confused - for emotional relief
verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ. وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ. الَّذِي أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
verses.transliteration: Alam nashrah laka sadrak. Wa wada'na 'anka wizrak. Alladhi anqada zahrak
verses.translation: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast? And We removed from you your burden. Which had weighed upon your back.

verses.name: Allah is Sufficient
verses.theme: Trust in Allah's plan - He is enough for all your needs
verses.connection: Ketu in Pisces - Surrender to divine providence
verses.practice: Recite when feeling alone, abandoned, or without support
verses.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهَ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا
verses.transliteration: Wa man yatawakkal 'ala Allahi fahuwa hasbuh. Inna Allaha balighu amrih. Qad ja'ala Allaha likulli shay'in qadra
verses.translation: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.

verses.name: The Cave - Protection
verses.theme: Protection through dhikr - The sleepers of the cave
verses.connection: Saturn in Aquarius - Long-term spiritual protection
verses.practice: Recite Surah Al-Kahf on Friday for protection from Dajjal (7 min)
verses.arabic: إِذْ أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
verses.transliteration: Idh awa al-fityatu ila al-kahfi fa-qalu rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada
verses.translation: When the youths retreated to the cave and said, 'Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.'

verses.name: The Inevitable
verses.theme: The Hour is coming - Accountability and ultimate reality
verses.connection: Mercury in Dhanishta - Truth-telling and revelation of the inevitable
verses.practice: Recite Surah Al-Waqi'ah × 1 weekly for protection from poverty
verses.arabic: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ. لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ. خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Idha waqa'atil-waqi'ah. Laysa li-waq'atiha kadhibah. Khafidatun rafi'ah
verses.translation: When the Occurrence occurs. There is, at its [occurrence], no denial. It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

verses.name: Divine Victory
verses.theme: The help of Allah is near - Victory through surrender
verses.connection: Jupiter in Sagittarius - Divine victory and expansion
verses.practice: Recite when seeking victory or closing a deal - × 100 times
verses.arabic: إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ. وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا. فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
verses.transliteration: Idha ja'a nasru Allahi wal-fath. Wa ra'aita an-nasa yadkhuluna fi dinil-lahi afwaja. Fa sabbih bi-hamdi rabbika wastaghfirh. Inna kana tawwaba
verses.translation: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest. And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes. Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.

verses.name: Night Prayer
verses.theme: The night recitation - Standing in prayer while others sleep
verses.connection: Mercury in Dhanishta - Late-night spiritual practice for writers
verses.practice: Recite Surah Al-Muzzammil at night for increased spiritual reward
verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Inna sanulqi 'alayka qawlan thaqila
verses.translation: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

verses.name: The Most High
verses.theme: Glorification of Allah - The highest level of spiritual awareness
verses.connection: Saturn in Aquarius - Divine majesty and transcendence
verses.practice: Recite after Fajr for spiritual elevation and protection
verses.arabic: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى. الَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ. وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ. وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ. فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Sabbih isma rabbikal-a'la. Alladhi khalaqa fasawwa. Wal-ladhi qaddara fahada. Wal-ladhi akhraja al-mar'a. Faja'alahu ghusa'an ahwa
verses.translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High. Who created and proportioned. And who determined [the design] and guided. And who brings out the pasture. And makes it dry stubble, dark.

verses.name: The Sun
verses.theme: Purification of the soul - The sun as witness of truth
verses.connection: Sun in Aquarius (Purva Bhadra) - Spiritual illumination and truth
verses.practice: Recite for inner purification and spiritual clarity
verses.arabic: وَالشَّمْسِ وَمَا سَحَرَهَا. وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا. وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا. وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا. وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا. وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا. وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا. فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا. قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّاهَا. وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّاهَا
verses.transliteration: Wash-shamsi wa ma sahara. Wal-qamari idha tala. Wan-nahari idha jallaha. Wal-layli idha yaghshaha. Was-sama'i wa ma banaha. Wal-ardi wa ma tahaha. Wa nafsin wa ma sawwaha. Fa-alhamaha fujooraha wa taqwaha. Qad aflaha man zakkaha. Wa qad khaba man dassaha
verses.translation: By the sun and its brightness. And by the moon as it follows it. And by the day as it displays it. And by the night as it conceals it. And by the sky and He who built it. And by the earth and He who spread it. And by the soul and He who proportioned it. And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness. He has succeeded who purifies it. And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

verses.name: The Declining Day
verses.theme: Time is running out - The oath of time itself
verses.connection: All placements - The urgency of spiritual practice
verses.practice: Recite for the value of time and urgency in good deeds
verses.arabic: وَالْعَصْرِ. إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ. إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-asr. Innal-insana lafi khusr. Illal-ladhina amanu wa 'amilu as-salihati wa tawasaw bil-haqqi wa tawasaw bil-sabr
verses.translation: By time. Indeed, mankind is in loss. Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

verses.name: The Abundance
verses.theme: Divine abundance - More than you can imagine
verses.connection: Jupiter in Sagittarius - Overflow of divine blessings
verses.practice: Recite × 100 before asking Allah for abundance - smallest surah, biggest reward
verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ. فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ ۖ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ
verses.transliteration: Inna a'taynaka al-kawthar. Fasalli li-rabbika wanhar. Inna shani'aka huwa al-abtar
verses.translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar. So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]. Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

verses.name: The Disbelievers
verses.theme: Firm stance in faith - No compromise in Tawhid
verses.connection: Saturn in Aquarius - Standing firm in principles
verses.practice: Recite to close the door on spiritual compromise - evening protection
verses.arabic: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ. لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ. وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ. وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ. وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ. لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ
verses.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuhal-kafirun. La a'budu ma ta'budun. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Wa la ana 'abidun ma 'abattum. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Lakum dinukum wa liya din
verses.translation: Say, 'O disbelievers. I do not worship what you worship. Nor are you worshippers of what I worship. Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship. Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship. For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.'

verses.name: Basmala
verses.theme: In the name of Allah - Foundation of all blessings
verses.connection: Mercury in Dhanishta - The opening of all affairs through divine name
verses.practice: Begin every action with this recitation
verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

protection_from_dajjal.use: Read on Friday — protection from Dajjal
Reminder that every matter has an appointed time
